verdict.rationale: Sumsub documents manual approve/reject of applicants in the dashboard, and the applicant profile shows check results such as the Liveness section plus a status and rejection-reason overview, so reviewer decisions are recorded on the applicant. Nothing documents borderline cases being routed automatically into a dedicated review queue, or the reviewer view showing document images and extracted fields. missing for 10: automatic routing of borderline cases into a manual review queue, evidence that the reviewer view shows document images and extracted fields, documentation of how decisions feed back into the record, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops lead, borderline verifications land in a manual review queue with the full evidence — document images, extracted fields, check results — and reviewer decisions feed back into the record

citations.quote: You can approve or reject an applicant regardless of their status, except when there are documents in the Pending status
In the profile, navigate to the Liveness section and review the results.
